pyqgis_plugin.name: AutoGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Autonomous Geospatial AI Agent, IBM AssetOpsBench Infrastructure Digital Twin, Live MCP & GAS 2.0 Bridge with GeoSAM-v2, Xerj AI, VeriGeo, GeoRAG & 82 Tools
pyqgis_plugin.about: AutoGIS is an open-source, standalone Autonomous Geospatial AI Agent, IBM AssetOpsBench Spatial Infrastructure Digital Twin, Live MCP & GAS 2.0 Server, and Spatial Analysis Studio for QGIS. Connect Cloud AI (Claude 3.7, Gemini 3, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, OpenRouter) or fully Offline Local AI (Ollama / LM Studio) to IBM AssetOpsBench (IoT Telemetry, FMSR Root-Cause Diagnostics, TSFM Time-Series Forecasting, Automated Maximo Geo-Work Orders), GeoSAM-v2 feature extraction, GeoRAG natural language spatial querying, Xerj AI Spatial Intelligence, VeriGeo Verification, 100+ Layer Streaming Datacubes, Satellite Change Detection, GAS 2.0 Multi-Agent Swarms, GEE, and PyQGIS workflows across 82 autonomous tools.
